Question: Suppose that a test statistic has associated with it a p-value of 0.08. Which one of the following statements is true?
(i) If the size of the test were exactly 8%, we would be indifferent between rejecting and not rejecting the null hypothesis
(ii) The null would be rejected if a 10% size of test were used
(iii) The null would not be rejected if a 1% size of test were used
(iv) The null would be rejected if a 5% size of test were used.
Options: A. (iii) and (iv) only
B. (i) and (iv) only
C. (i), (ii), and (iii) only
D. (i) and (ii) only
E. (i) and (iii) only
F. (i), (ii), (iii), and (iv).
G. (ii), (iii), and (iv) only
H. (ii) and (iii) only
I. (ii) and (iv) only
J. (i), (iii), and (iv) only
Answer: Let's think step by step and then finish your answer with 'the answer is (X)' where X is the correct letter choice.assistant
response:
Step 1: Understand the p-value and its relationship to the null hypothesis.
The p-value represents the probability of observing a result as extreme or more extreme than the one observed, assuming that the null hypothesis is true. A small p-value (e.g., 0.08) indicates strong evidence against the null hypothesis.

Step 2: Analyze each statement in the context of the p-value.
(i) If the size of the test were exactly 8%, we would be indifferent between rejecting and not rejecting the null hypothesis: This statement is false because a p-value of 0.08 is greater than the test size of 8%, so we would reject the null hypothesis.

Step 3: (ii) The null would be rejected if a 10% size of test were used: This statement is false because a p-value of 0.08 is less than the test size of 10%, so we would reject the null hypothesis.

Step 4: (iii) The null would not be rejected if a 1% size of test were used: This statement is false because a p-value of 0.08 is greater than the test size of 1%, so we would reject the null hypothesis.

Step 5: (iv) The null would be rejected if a 5% size of test were used: This statement is true because a p-value of 0.08 is less than the test size of 5%, so we would reject the null hypothesis.

Step 6: Based on the analysis, the correct answer is the one that includes only statements (i) and (iv) as true.

The answer is B.
